dimensions.assessment: Directly affects surviving spouses of certain members of the Armed Forces and veterans who qualify as eligible persons under the expanded program definition.

dimensions.assessment: Provides career and employment services to an expanded group of spouses.
dimensions.evidence: eligible person defined... means any spouse described in section 4101(5) of this title; or the spouse of any person who died while a member of the Armed Forces

dimensions.assessment: Expands an existing Department of Labor outreach program to cover additional individuals, though specific funding changes are not stated.
Amends title 38, United States Code, to add spouses to the statutory definition of eligible persons for outreach services.
dimensions.evidence: Section 4103A of title 38, United States Code, is amended

dimensions.assessment: Permanent statutory expansion of program eligibility.

importance_detail.rationale: The bill expands eligibility for the Disabled Veterans' Outreach Program to include certain surviving spouses and spouses of members who died while serving or have severe service-connected disabilities.

card.summary: S. 2296, the National Defense Authorization Act for Fiscal Year 2026, sets policies, authorities, and funding levels for Department of Defense programs, military construction, and Department of Energy national security programs. It also incorporates numerous specific acts concerning intelligence activities, coast guard operations, maritime systems, housing reforms, and state department authorizations.
